citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Quadruples the Dr. Serapio B. Montañer Jr., Al-Haj Memorial Hospital from 25 beds to 100, with the medical workforce required to grow correspondingly.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: The act declares a policy of maintaining and ensuring basic and responsive health programmes, promoting the right to health, instilling health consciousness, and adopting comprehensive and integrated health service delivery.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: Authorised capacity rises from 25 to 100 beds under national Department of Health classification standards, with doctors, nurses, midwives, other health practitioners and support personnel increased in accordance with Civil Service rules.
who_will_be_affected: Doctors, nurses, midwives and other health practitioners, whose numbers must rise
The Ministry of Health, which supervises and must immediately programme the implementation
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2025 — 15 days after publication.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Short title: the “Dr. Serapio B. Montañer Jr., Al-Haj Memorial Hospital Act of 2025”.

Section 2 — Policy: the Bangsamoro Government shall maintain and ensure the delivery of basic and responsive health programmes, promote the right to health of the Bangsamoro people, instill health consciousness, and adopt comprehensive and integrated health service delivery.
Section 3 — Upgrades the hospital from its present 25-bed capacity to 100 beds, in accordance with the National Level Classification Standards set by the Department of Health.

Section 4 — The existing manpower, including doctors, nurses, midwives, other health practitioners and support personnel, shall be increased correspondingly in accordance with Civil Service rules and regulations.

Section 5 — The hospital remains under the administrative supervision and control of the Ministry of Health, which approves the appropriate organisational structure and personnel, and the hospital plans, programmes and activities.

Section 6 — An initial ₱50,000,000 is appropriated and charged against the 2025 General Appropriations Act of the Bangsamoro, with funds for continued operation and maintenance thereafter in the annual appropriations. The Ministry of Health shall immediately include the implementation of the act in its programmes.
Section 7 — Within 60 days of effectivity the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Finance, and Budget and Management shall promulgate the implementing rules and regulations.
Section 10 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in a newspaper of general circulation in the region.
